fieldConstraints.qualification_ref: qualification://<authorityId>/<inputId>@sha256:<exact input PC-CBOR payload SHA256 lowercase hex>
fieldConstraints.nfc_text_1_128: valid NFC UTF-8, 1..128 bytes, no control characters
fieldConstraints.safe_uint: unsigned safe integer 0..9007199254740991; time intervals strictly ordered
fieldConstraints.u64p: decimal API string 1..18446744073709551615, canonical CBOR uint

fieldConstraints.uuidv7: exact 16-byte canonical UUIDv7 with RFC variant

authorityRules: First bounded qualification owner: provider.read_retry_limit only, exact UINT8 value 0..3, exact QINPUT-<UPPERCASE PROFILE>-PROVIDER-READ-RETRY-V1 slot. This does not authorize other qualification slots or widen the accepted configuration schema.

The exact method and authenticated methodProfileDigest must resolve through the owning provider/method contract and demonstrate RETRY_SAFE_READ. A caller-supplied safety/currentness flag, unrelated endpoint qualification or generic provider health check cannot establish this predicate.

Input identity is SHA-256 of the exact canonical PC-CBOR payload including definition identity. Its reference is qualification://<authorityId>/<inputId>@sha256:<payload digest without prefix>. The input contains neither that reference nor any receipt, generation or effective-configuration digest; a later executed receipt binds the input. This removes self-reference and input/receipt/configuration digest cycles.

The selected authenticated C17 schema/profile, environment, subject/build/source tree, workload, method identity and exact setting value must all match the qualified subject and the consuming generation. A valid input signature alone is an unqualified design input and clears no generation blocker.

Implements only an internal adapter contract for authenticated operations qualification under the adopted ASTRA-14/16 plan. The delivered C17 authority remains DESIGNED_NOT_CONSTITUTED with keys UNPROVISIONED; local external test signers prove adapter behavior only. No production qualification, certification, SLO/SLA or product claim promotion follows.

Use existing PC-CBOR-1 and COSE_Sign1 ES256/P-256/SHA-256 profile 2, exact schema definition/AAD/purpose and exact original bytes. The verifier rejects unknown/duplicate/noncanonical fields, malformed identities, type coercion, key/purpose substitution, mutable references and ambiguous signature outcomes. Retain first failures and originals.

For JSON document digest preimages use RFC8785 with duplicate-key/NFC rejection and exact closed schemas. Every fixed signatureEnvelope descriptor is exactly {format:COSE_Sign1,algorithm:ES256,curve:P-256,hash:SHA-256,canonicalization:PC-CBOR-1}. ISO times are canonical UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ representing the exact signed millisecond field. Document digest fields use the prefix-free form required by C17; signed H32 claims use the canonical sha256: representation.

Privileged durable installation, RLS/tenant context, independent issuer eligibility, actual execution/reviewer evidence, current keyset/revocation checks and the exact generation binding remain separate required owners. These public wire declarations do not create tables, grants, runtime APIs, qualification success, effective configuration or any signing/send effect.

Bound and copy document bytes before parsing: input payload 65536 bytes, receipt document 524288 bytes, keyset document 131072 bytes and revocation document 4194304 bytes maximum. Unknown fields, duplicate keys, non-NFC strings, malformed entries and partial snapshots fail closed before database allocation.
